title: 山寺「美登屋」— でわかおりの手打ちそばとだしそば
summary: 山寺の「美登屋」。山形県産「でわかおり」の手打ち二八そば、郷土料理「だし」をのせた「だしそば」が紹介されています。

cover.alt: 手打ちそばとだしそばを描いた水彩調イラスト

en.title: Yamadera "Mitoya" — Handmade Soba with Dewakaori, and Dashi Soba
en.summary: "Mitoya" in Yamadera. Handmade nihachi soba using Yamagata-grown "Dewakaori" buckwheat, and "dashi soba" topped with the local dish "dashi," are introduced.
en.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of handmade soba and dashi soba
en.html:
This is "Mitoya" in Yamadera.

An Instagram post (@yamadera_tourism_association) introduces its carefully made handmade nihachi soba, using "Dewakaori" grown in Yamagata Prefecture. The "dashi soba," topped with Yamagata's local dish "dashi," is also recommended, and can be enjoyed along with the riverside scenery.

Shop Information (from the post)

  • Shop Name: Mitoya
  • Location: Yamadera (the exact address was not specified in the post — please check)
  • Specialties: Handmade nihachi soba (Dewakaori), dashi soba

Source

  • Instagram Reel (@yamadera_tourism_association): https://www.instagram.com/reel/DetdhMYBYkj/
  • Business hours, closing days, and other details may change. Please check with the shop for the latest information.

markdown:
山寺にある「美登屋」です。

Instagram の投稿（@yamadera_tourism_association）では、山形県産「でわかおり」を使用した、こだわりの手打ち二八そばが紹介されています。山形の郷土料理「だし」をのせた「だしそば」もおすすめとのことで、川沿いの景色とともに楽しめるとのことです。
